_guide.note: Canonical engineering terms. Page files reference these with {@term.key}. Read note/help before changing wording. Do not duplicate a term's exact wording in page files.

term.configured_reference.note: Configured nominal comparison reference shown on Measurement charts. IS NOT a product acceptance target or PASS/FAIL threshold.
term.configured_reference.help: The configured comparison marker. It is not a pass or fail line.

term.configured_reference_interval.note: Host Evidence numeric label for 1000 / Reference Rate. Distinct from observed Interval and from matched timing error. IS NOT a PASS/FAIL threshold.
term.configured_reference_interval.help: The nominal interval derived from the configured Reference Rate, used as Host Evidence context.

term.hold.note: Same-click release minus press. Distinct from Interval (press-to-press).
term.hold.help: How long the button stayed down for that click.

term.host_observation.note: An accepted Host-observed input record. IS NOT PASS, a normal/good click, or a DUT verdict.
term.host_observation.help: A button press the Host capture path accepted and recorded.

term.host_observations.note: Plural group heading for Host observation records. Grammatical variant of Host observation, not a different metric.
term.host_observations.help: The group of accepted Host-observed input records.

term.host_observations_ambiguous.note: Schedule-association status only. IS NOT a DUT FAIL/WARN verdict.
term.host_observations_ambiguous.help: Host observations that could belong to more than one schedule slot.

term.host_observations_in_capture.note: Count of Host observations inside the capture window. Distinct from recorded (includes outside-capture) and from matched.
term.host_observations_in_capture.help: How many Host observations fall inside the capture window.

term.host_observations_matched.zh-TW: 已匹配排程的主機觀測
term.host_observations_matched.note: Deterministic schedule association status. IS NOT correct DUT behavior or validation PASS.
term.host_observations_matched.help: Host observations associated with exactly one schedule slot.

term.host_observations_outside_capture.note: Schedule-association status OUTSIDE_CAPTURE_WINDOW. IS NOT a DUT verdict. These records never enter matching.
term.host_observations_outside_capture.help: Host observations recorded outside the capture window.

term.host_observations_recorded.note: Raw accepted Host observation count, including outside-capture. Distinct from in-capture and from Host Presses display on some surfaces.
term.host_observations_recorded.help: All accepted Host observations recorded for the run.

term.host_observations_unmatched.en: Host observations not matched to schedule
term.host_observations_unmatched.zh-TW: 未匹配排程的主機觀測
term.host_observations_unmatched.note: Deterministic schedule association status UNMATCHED. IS NOT a DUT FAIL.
term.host_observations_unmatched.help: In-capture Host observations that were not associated with a schedule slot.

term.host_presses.note: Count label for accepted Host presses. Related to Host observation but kept as a count/grammar variant so UI copy stays natural. IS NOT a PASS count.
term.host_presses.help: How many accepted button presses the Host recorded.

term.above_configured_range.note: Observed interval is greater than the configured upper bound. Factual position only. IS NOT FAIL, abnormal, or a DUT verdict.
term.above_configured_range.help: This interval is longer than the upper bound of the engineer-configured range.

term.below_configured_range.note: Observed interval is less than the configured lower bound. Factual position only. IS NOT FAIL, abnormal, or a DUT verdict.
term.below_configured_range.help: This interval is shorter than the lower bound of the engineer-configured range.

term.configured_interval_range.note: Engineer-configured inclusive bounds around the Reference Interval. Distinct from Schedule Association Window. IS NOT a PASS/FAIL criterion.
term.configured_interval_range.help: The interval bounds the engineer configured for comparison.

term.configured_range.note: Short chart/legend form of Configured interval range. Presentation band only. IS NOT a pass range, acceptable range, or failure zone.
term.configured_range.help: The engineer-configured interval bounds drawn on the chart.

term.interval.note: Press-to-press interval. Distinct from Hold and from Reference Interval / matched timing error.
term.interval.help: Time from one press to the next press.

term.interval_comparison.note: Optional Fixture comparison of observed press intervals against a configured range. Distinct from Schedule Association. IS NOT a DUT verdict.
term.interval_comparison.help: Compares each observed press-to-press interval with the engineer-configured range.

term.outside_configured_range.note: Observed interval is below or above the configured bounds. Factual position only. IS NOT FAIL.
term.outside_configured_range.help: This interval is outside the engineer-configured range.

term.range_position.note: Factual Within / Below / Above / not comparable label for one observed interval. IS NOT a DUT result column.
term.range_position.help: Where this observed interval sits relative to the configured range.

term.within_configured_range.note: Observed interval is inside the inclusive configured bounds. Factual position only. IS NOT PASS or a good click.
term.within_configured_range.help: This interval is inside the engineer-configured range.

term.measurement_only.note: No approved Screening or Validation Profile is applied. IS NOT a run result state.
term.measurement_only.help: This run records measurements without applying a screening or validation profile.

term.mode_fixture.note: Software capture mode. Does NOT prove physical fixture actuation. Not an actuation_source.
term.mode_fixture.help: Software mode that compares Host observations to a configured schedule.

term.mode_manual.note: Software capture mode for operator-driven clicking. Distinct from Fixture mode.
term.mode_manual.help: Software mode for operator-driven clicking without a fixture schedule.

term.reference_interval.note: Derived as 1000 / Reference Rate. Distinct from observed Interval, matched timing error, and the Host Evidence label Configured reference interval.
term.reference_interval.help: The nominal interval computed from the configured Reference Rate.

term.reference_rate.note: Configured nominal rate. Do not call this Fixture Frequency or Fixture Hz on Measurement surfaces. Persisted as fixture_reference_hz; calculation is unchanged.
term.reference_rate.help: The configured rate used to derive the Reference Interval.

term.run_status.note: Display heading for capture/run data status. The stored tokens COMPLETE / NO_DATA / INVALID stay machine-authoritative.
term.run_status.help: Whether the capture produced usable Host press data.

term.run_status_complete.note: Display label for machine token COMPLETE: at least one accepted Host press. IS NOT validation PASS. Do not localize the stored token.
term.run_status_complete.help: The run recorded at least one accepted Host press.

term.run_status_invalid.note: Display label for machine token INVALID: capture validity problem. Do not localize the stored token.
term.run_status_invalid.help: The capture source or recorded button did not match the run setup.

term.run_status_no_data.note: Display label for machine token NO_DATA: zero accepted presses. Do not localize the stored token.
term.run_status_no_data.help: The run finished with no accepted Host presses.

term.schedule_association_window.note: Schedule-matching half-width only. IS NOT a DUT acceptance tolerance or PASS/FAIL threshold. Persisted as fixture_timing_tolerance_ms.
term.schedule_association_window.help: Defines the ± time window used to associate a Host observation with a nominal schedule slot.
